collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official OpenCode Go docs page and landing page (English) around 10:33 Beijing time / 02:33Z on 2026-10-23. Official per-model pricing table, per-model Monthly limit, the usage-window rule, the official 'Estimated requests' table and the landing-page Go model table were read as published. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed.
scope: OpenCode Go official price table only. One catalog entry changed: 'MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free' (2026-10-20 → 2026-10-22) was replaced on 2026-10-23 by the paid row 'MiniMax M3.1 Flash'. No leaderboard/score data, no Command Code GOAT change (cross-channel note only), no shared-pool change, no other OpenCode model row changed, no adopted.csv row.
adoptionStatus: research-only; not adopted; no opencode_go × minimax-m3.1-flash row in adopted.csv yet — adding one requires an OPENCODE_GO_MODELS entry in scripts/build_adopted.py, left to maintainer review
